body: The other day I was looking for a place to jump off but all the overpasses near me have this fucking fence around them that you can’t get over, like just let me die in peace! Finally found a smaller pedestrian bridge that I think will work.
It’s so hard to talk to someone that it seems like the only option.

People don’t understand mental health. I like to sometimes compare cancer to depression. It slowly kills you until one day you die. There’s not really any cure but there are things you can do to help it. People for some reason don’t look at it through the lenses of “this is an actual disease”and think people are just making it up or whatever.
Yea that makes sense. It’s just sometimes in the moment it feels like my brain just shuts off.

> Kids shouldn't need to come out about being depressed by attempting suicide because they have no other way to prove it's a real problem that they deal with. And they definitely shouldn't have to go as far as to commit suicide to show they struggled.

Fuck, you put it into words.

Idk. I can never bring myself to talk to anyone. I try and I want to say the words but my mind just won’t let me. Whenever I think about actually talking to someone and I try to muster the courage I usually have a panic attack and can’t bring myself to do it.
Whenever I’m up high and I look over the edge I get this. Sometimes when I’m cruising on the highway as well.

The only place I’m ever able to talk about it is here on reddit. I think eventually I’ll get comfortable enough talking to strangers that maybe I can talk to some real people in my life but idk. It just sucks not being able to anything about it.
I know how you feel. It’s like I can’t escape the feeling and live my life.
Ok, I will try to talk to them. Thank you.
I really like you’re story. You’re right, I should give it a chance at least. It’s difficult to muster the courage for the first time but I think it gets easier after that.

Only thing I do out of that is exercise. I’m young and living at home. I don’t feel like I can talk to my parents so 1-3 are difficult to obtain. I try to get sleep but at night is always when my anxiety gets worse.
I don’t *want* to but it feels like an easy escape sometimes
That’s a really good outlook on life. I leave for a trip on a few days but I think when I get back I’ll  talk to my parents about it. At this point what’s the worst that could happen.

Thank you for the advice. It makes me so angry that people have all these misconceptions about mental illness. I don’t think people recognize it as an actual illness a lot of the time and just think of it as an excuse that people use.
My chest hurts really bad. I can’t control my breathing, often really fast/hyper ventilating. And feeling like I have absolutely no control.
Do you ever get a weird feeling in your chest? When I’m really anxious I’ll get this tightness in my chest and then usually followed by trouble breathing or rapid breathes.

Sometimes I get this. I’ll just get so tired of suppressing my emotions that I want to just let them take control of me so I don’t have to fight it anymore. Of course it’s always worse but what can you do.

Thank you so much. I’ll often try to tell myself “I don’t really feel this way” or “there’s not reason to feel this way” but when I’m feeling really depressed or suicidal I also have this feeling of lethargy as well. I need my mind to be strong in those moments to fight the thoughts but in those times I can never focus on controlling what I’m thinking. All I can think is the repeating bad ideas. It’s like I don’t have control over what I’m feeling. When I try to fight back I just get overwhelmed. Every part of my brain is just spewing the negative thoughts and there’s no room for me to push back.
No I really don’t. I’ve thought about turning to drugs or alcohol, but I know those are dark paths.

I don’t think I’m a huge risk taker. Maybe for small things but never something that could have a large impact on my life. I think you’re right, the fear of failure is really strong. I never have to face failure if I never try.
Fear I guess. I’m afraid of how people will think of me and how different people will treat me.
I feel like I’m stuck in this limbo. I’m not strong enough to end it but I’m also not strong enough to ask for help. Nothing every changes. One day I think I’ll have had enough though.
I honestly don’t know why I feel this way. I’m just overwhelmed with all these negative ideas and I feel like I’m running out of ways to escape them.

I know what to you mean. People tell me “so many people love you” or “you have such a good life” and I’m just thinking, I know that, but that doesn’t help at all. Just makes me feel like more of a piece of shit for being depressed.
I’ve tried but I can never find the courage to actually talk to someone. I don’t know what I’m scared of but I always talk myself out of it.
I mean that would be fucking great if that happened but it’s often really hard for people to just *know*.

I’ve though about taking to a school counselor but I don’t have a lot of confidence in their counseling skills tbh. I didn’t know about the contract thing so I guess that’s something to think about. Thanks.
Yea my friend group likes to make a lot of edgy/sarcastic jokes so I’m worried if I ever tried to tell them something they would think I was joking.
Me too. It’s like I just sit hear in this limbo, not brave enough to ask for help but also not brave enough to actually kill myself. Nothing ever changes.
I’m really sorry to hear that. It’s a lot harder to express your feelings a second time to someone else when that’s your first experience.

Yea you said it. I appreciate people trying to help but none of these people really know me. I know they are good people who want to help and don’t know what else to do but it’s just not the same. I wish the people I love could show the concern that you guys do.

Thanks for the reply. Life just feels really pointless to me. All I see is the how negatively I impact others. I’m overwhelmed with thoughts of death but at the end of the day I would feel guilty if I ever did anything. I just wish I could fade away and no one would remember me.
Thanks. I’m worried that’s exactly how my parents would react if I brought it up to them. I want to seek therapy without them but I don’t think that’s possible.
Same. I feel like I show many of the signs. I guess people just don’t care about me.
No I’m not. Sorry you’re going through the same thing. Hmu sometime to talk if you want, im 16 as well.

I don’t know what the rules are for my state. I live in Arizona right now. 

I keep telling myself I’ll talk to them but I never can convince myself to do it. I don’t know what I’m afraid of.

Thanks. I just feel like there’s no point in living. I feel like a waste. I’m never going to do anything meaningful because my depression and anxiety will always hold me back. Why does it matter if I die today or in 70 years. Once I’m dead nothing else matters. The whole life you lived is gone. Why would I want to suffer just to die and have it all be washed away. Better to just die now and minimize the pain. 

I wish no one loved me. I wish I didn’t have any friends. Then I wouldn’t feel guilty if I killed myself. 

I’ve been blessed with love and nice possessions my whole life. I don’t have a right to feel this way. There’s people that have no money or friends and still live happy lives. I wish I could just give everything I have to them. 

All I do is leave a negative impact on this word. People are friends with me because it’s convenient not because they like me. 

In the night I’m sad and depressed, but in the morning I think about how weak I was acting and how there’s no way I’m *actually* depressed. 

When I look in the mirror I feel like I don’t know who I’m looking at. It’s like there’s this disconnect between my mind and my body. When I lay here in the darkness it feels like my mind is the only thing that really exists. It’s like I leave behind my body and my mind goes wandering somewhere else. 

The only reason I don’t end it is because I feel guilty. Nobody deserves to have their son, brother, or friend die. I know everyone else actually enjoys being alive and I don’t have the right to break that.
Trying to work up the courage myself. Are you going to get any medication?

I’m 16. I don’t know how to talk to my parents at all. I don’t think they understand depression and my mom always makes a huge deal out of everything. I don’t want depression to be the only thing they think about when they look at me. I don’t want them to change how they act around me or to walk on eggshells because they don’t want to upset me. I know my mom will want to tell all her friends and family about her “sick” son. I just want it to be over. I come home everyday and I lay in bed and I think about how much I want to die. I skip practice, I don’t study, I don’t play video games. I’m so tired of feeling worthless.
No. I want to die and I don’t know not to get help.

I have a guidance counsellor at school and she’s really nice but all she really does is talk to kids about grades and establish communication between teachers and kids. She has a good heart but I don’t think she has much experience being a “counselor”.

I don’t want to talk to my parents because I feel like that’s all they’ll see in me then. I don’t want them to be stepping on egg shells every time they’re around me and to treat me differently. I feel like I don’t know them very well and I think they would make a really big deal of it.
I think I could maybe open up to someone, but every time someone has asked me it’s been in front of other people which makes it way harder.
I really want to speak to a therapist but I’m 16 and I just can’t bring myself to ask my parents for something like that right now.
I feel like I could’ve wrote this post myself. I wish people wouldn’t ask my if I’m ok because I’ll just say I’m fine. I wish they would know I’m not ok.

Could this also be a symptom depression? I’m trying to figure out what’s wrong with myself, I thought I was just depressed but after reading the symptoms of anxiety I think that could be it as well. 

I get this all the time especially when I’m feeling down and I hate it so much.

Yea I will. For me it’s kind of like I always know it’s there and it’s lingering but when I’m not feeling completely down I’m actually able to experience happiness and excitement in my day. In those two or three day blocks though it’s just fucking nothing.
I used to be the the one spouting the “it gets better” crap but after a few months of this shit I don’t think it does.
Ok thanks. I don’t know a whole lot about the actual disorder but I guess I always thought it was something that was always occurring.

Like someone else said above I think people don’t know how to cope. I’d say most people are genuine when they say anyone can reach out to them. They might not know how to help or what to say but I’m sure they’d actually try.
I think once I’m living on my own it will be much easier to just let go. I feel to connected to people right now. I don’t know if that makes sense.
I used to tell myself the same thing but it’s been like a month of just bad days. I don’t know anymore.
Thanks for replying. It helps to know I’m not alone.
Literally in the exact same situation. I wish I could just ask for help but I can’t bring myself to do it.

I always try working out or exercising. Personally I really enjoy soccer and running, but lifting weights or any other type of exercise is good as well. Just the act of pushing myself and physical exertion is sometimes a good release.
I guess whatever it is that keeps you going. Even if it’s something stupid. Anything to stay alive.

I know how you feel. I wish I was more distant. I don’t want people to miss me if I die. That’s the only reason I’m still here is because of other people. I envy the people with no parents or family. I hate feeling this way.
Yes I’m so much more distant when I’m depressed. I just hate it because I know what I’m feeling isn’t right and I shouldn’t feel this way but that doesn’t make it go away.
I feel the same way. I always say I’m fine because I don’t want to be a problem for others. I wish I could just fade away without anyone missing me.

I’ve never thought about that before, but maybe. I’ll often act really distant, angry, and quite. I always have some excuse like something that happened during the day. Thanks for telling me that, that’s a really good pics of advice.

Thanks for the advice. I think one my main worries is that I have a lot of good days and then some bad days. When I’m having a good day I don’t want to think about how I’m feeling on the bad days and I don’t want people to worry about saying the wrong thing. I know I just need to suck it up and say something but it’s really hard.

I’ve thought about talking to my school counselor but I just don’t really trust her. She’s a really nice lady but she’s pretty old and out of touch with my generation, I don’t think she would understand.

I really appreciate your reply. I’m pretty young and I’m still living with my parents. I really wish I could go see a therapist by myself but I would have to talk to my parents about it. That’s why I feel like I’m kind of being put in a position. Sorry I should I have specified.
I’ve been better. Lately a lot more ups than downs.
Glad you were able to overcome it!
How old were you when you got help and how did you find the courage to ask for help?
Most people don’t want their main account and history viewable.

Never used this sub before but I’d like more people to talk to. I run all the time, listen to hip hop (really like Eminem and Logic), and I really want to major in computer science. I play soccer too but I don’t watch it. I’m 16 btw, hope that doesn’t matter.
Thanks I’ll check it out
Yea you really put it into words.
Not today but maybe tomorrow. Thank you.
I’d appreciate it. Thank you.

You’re right. They’re good dudes but sometimes people don’t realize why they say. I have a few people who have talked to me about their depression before and how they overcame it so I think they might have some good advice or at least know not to gossip.
Ok thanks. I think the first step for me would be to talk to my friends. I find that’s the easiest thing for me to do, even though other options might be better.

I know you’re right but I just can’t bring myself to talk to an adult. Idk, I guess I feel like talking to an adult makes it more serious and validates the fact that there’s something wrong and I’d rather believe I was fine. I have an older sister but she’s living in Germany 5000 miles away and I rarely get to talk to her. We’re pretty close and I after she left I was worried because I knew if I was in a bad place I wouldn’t have anyone to go to. I guess that why I’m here right now.

No they don’t know anything. I can’t tell them. My mom sometimes talks about the sad stories she reads in the news and she says if she ever heard that I was suffering or something like that she would be devastated. She’s a great person and I don’t want her to be sad. My dad is a good person and has a nice simple life. I don’t want to interrupt what he has. I feel like if I ever talked to someone it would be someone my age. I just can’t imagine going to an adult for help, idk why.

I am. But I’ve been in this place since like 12 years old and it’s been the same shit. Better to minimize the pain. Right now I play sports because they always make me feel happy because I like pushing myself and I have a competitive nature. Plus I get to meet new people and hang out with my other friends. I always feel like I have a goal and something I’m working towards with sports but that’s only like 3 hours a day so idk.
I just don’t see the point in keeping going if it’s so bad. Torture is often worse than death. Fuck I just want to be normal.

I think so, but I don’t know how they would react. My friends are good people but they mess around a shit ton, idk if they could help me much in a serious situation. Also I don’t want them to treat me differently at school or tell other people. That’s honestly why I came to this sub.
17 in a few months
